items.title: Frost Advisory issued April 24 at 2:47AM PDT until April 24 at 10:00AM PDT by NWS Portland OR
items.summary:
* WHAT...Temperatures as low as 33 will result in frost formation.

* WHERE...Upper Hood River Valley.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM PDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive
outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The highest threat for frost will be above
1000 feet elevation, where temperatures will fall near 32 degrees.
Below 1000 feet elevation, temperatures in the mid to upper 30s
may result in patchy frost.
